subject: Pottery class follow-up
text: Two days ago, you mentioned the new pottery class you started at the community center, and I have spent the past afternoon organizing my thoughts about it because I was genuinely interested rather than simply being polite. I decided to return to the topic after checking my own schedule and realizing that Thursday evenings are the only blocks that remain consistently clear for me. My current routine is mostly lectures, reading, and part of the weekend spent at the campus library, so any hobby needs to be practical and nearby. The idea of working with clay appeals to me because it offers a physical task that does not require a screen, which is unusual for my week. I also liked that you described the class as beginner-friendly and not especially competitive. I have never done ceramics before, and I suspect the first sessions will involve a great deal of instruction about centering, pressure, and patience. Still, I thought it would be useful to ask whether there is an open place, what kind of clothing is advisable, and whether the studio provides tools or if students bring their own supplies. If none of that fits your experience, I would still appreciate a direct answer about when registration closes. My schedule may become tighter after midterms, but I would prefer to try a short session before deciding whether the hobby suits me. I will keep this practical and not overthink the logistics beyond what the website leaves unclear.
